name: Arduino (2)
info:
| Trigger / Context             | Topic             | Message     | Notes                                       |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| BLE LED turned ON             | 2474042/feeds/led | #close      | Indicates the lock/window closed            |
| BLE LED turned OFF            | 2474042/feeds/led | #away       | Indicates LED is OFF                        |
| Web keypad '*' pressed        | 2474042/feeds/led | <position>  | Sends current entered number for validation |
| Physical keypad '*' pressed   | 2474042/feeds/led | !<position> | Sends current entered number for validation |



| Expected Message   | Topic             | Notes                                        |
| ------------------ | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| #correctPassword   | 2474042/feeds/led | Unlock the lock; triggers LCD update         |X
| #incorrectPassword | 2474042/feeds/led | Wrong password; triggers LCD animation/reset |X
| #WIN_0             | 2474042/feeds/led | Sets windowStatus = 0                        |X
| #WIN_1             | 2474042/feeds/led | Sets windowStatus = 1                        |X
| #WIN_2             | 2474042/feeds/led | Sets windowStatus = 2                        |X
| #WIN_3             | 2474042/feeds/led | Sets windowStatus = 3                        |X
| #DOOR              | 2474042/feeds/led | Does something idk                           |X


If its "checked (X)" it means that node red has the nodes to do it (scroll for the top one -->).

name: X - Arduino (1) - X
info:
Ce Arduino n'utilise pas lq MQTT par contre il envoie du BT aux Arduino (2), qui envoie lui
meme du MQTT.


From Arduino (2):

| Trigger / Context             | Topic             | Message     | Notes                                       |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------- |X
| BLE LED turned ON             | 2474042/feeds/led | #close      | Indicates the lock/window closed            |*
| BLE LED turned OFF            | 2474042/feeds/led | #away       | Indicates LED is OFF   

It sends it to Arduino (2), and then Arduino (2) takes care of the rest.

name: Photon (1)
info:
| Message Payload | Topic                   | Action / Notes                           |
| --------------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| buzzerPulse     | cak47/Feeds/Ampoulelock | Short buzzer pulse                       |
| buzzerLong      | cak47/Feeds/Ampoulelock | Turns on long buzzer alert (`alerte=1`)  |
| buzzerBuzz      | cak47/Feeds/Ampoulelock | Continuous "earrape" buzzer (`alerte=2`) |
| buzzerOff       | cak47/Feeds/Ampoulelock | Turn off buzzer (`alerte=0`)             |
| ampoule         | cak47/Feeds/Ampoulelock | Turn ON lamp/ampoule                     |
| ampouleOff      | cak47/Feeds/Ampoulelock | Turn OFF lamp/ampoule                    |
| #unlock         | cak47/Feeds/Ampoulelock | Unlock the lock (digital HIGH on `lock`) |
